class_rules.AUTHORIZED_ALTERNATE_NATIVE_EVIDENCE: Specific alternate source/consumer authorization only; no continuous native history claim
class_rules.AUTHORIZED_PROSPECTIVE_REPLACEMENT: Only under the original specific authorization; independent runner-role applicability not yet sealed
class_rules.CANONICAL_NATIVE: Exact native role/version/parent/context pins; canonical tag alone insufficient
class_rules.OTHER: Protocol/oracle/code/manifest specifications only in corresponding role
class_rules.QUALIFICATION_PROJECTION: May supply documentary scoped mapping/provenance; cannot replace native event-bearing operands
class_rules.QUALIFIED_NATIVE: Local native qualification and exact source/oracle pairing retained; no automatic whole-runner coverage
class_rules.REPORT_ONLY: Can establish retained result/provenance only; cannot replace native state or actual process input
class_rules.SNAPSHOT_ONLY: Only Snapshot/model/archive roles; not event-bearing bundle or event ancestry
class_rules.STALE: Rejected for current native applicability; retain as historical provenance
